TITLE: IBS Batches – A Sent Batch Shows a Total $290.06 Higher Than the Invoices Inside It
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: SV-2144 (to confirm) · PRIORITY: Medium
STATUS: HELD — NOT FILED. Waiting for RQ-3 (does the batch Total have to equal its invoices?) and for the cause; file only after the PO answers "Yes".
REPRODUCED: the same batch, twice, on staging build v26.43.2-f8698cb, 28 Oct 2026. Not re-created on fresh data (removing an invoice from a batch updates the total correctly).

h2. Description

*On Reports > IBS Batches > Sent at Staging Lethbridge - 4310, the batch dated Oct 2, 2026 shows Total $9,473.35 and Balance $9,473.35, but the nine invoices listed inside it add up to $9,183.29.* The batch's own IBS export file also says "Invoices $9183.29". When this batch is paid, the payment window works from a total that is $290.06 too high.

*What is NOT affected:* the other Sent batches add up; the export file's invoice lines and amounts are right; Ready to Send lists only invoices of customers with an IBS number.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin. In the top bar, choose *Staging Lethbridge - 4310*.
# Open *Reports*. Under *Accounting* click *IBS Batches*.
# Click the *Sent* tab.
# Find the batch dated *Oct 2, 2026*. Note *Total* *$9,473.35*.
# Click its arrow to open it and add up the *Total* of the nine invoices.
#* They add up to *$9,183.29*.

*Actual Result:* the batch row says $9,473.35.

*Expected Result:* the batch row equals the invoices inside it: $9,183.29.

* Not caused by {{POST /api/customers/ibs/remove-from-batch}} (tested 28 Oct 2026: create batch of 2 → remove 1 → amount updated correctly). Possibly an invoice edited, voided or reversed after it was batched.
